basis: Director inspected the four actual source-matched development-check chatbox payloads before any main measurement. Source display remained enabled. This is field-format evidence, not translation-quality scoring or universal message identity.

rule.uncertainty: Bilingual field framing observed in both selected directions; the historical source-only observation supplies the empty-target case. No universal revision/page/resend/finality IDs or cross-packet grouping are established. Source text is application ASR, not reference truth. Newline or role ambiguities require preserved run-bound inspection; no restored text or manufactured page chain.

binding_policy: The preflight clocks and recv_seq identify evidence only; they are never copied as relationships or alignment links into main runs. Future correspondence and any explicit relationships require actual input/output-bound evidence under the frozen method.
